name: Crescent Rock Arch — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Asymmetric apricot crescent rock arch with turquoise/opal fracture veins, pearl-like accents and sparse hanging gold star lanterns above the tide. Front and tiny isometric do not fully resolve the far foot/overhang geometry. Hidden layout inference: Use a shoreline approach to one small viewing ledge, an optional low tidal pass beneath the arch when geometry allows, and a return beach path. Keep its open crescent silhouette as hero; no castle wall or formal palace courtyard added. Put lights only at established attachment crevices. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B11-STRUCT-001 — Crescent Rock Arch — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need source-shaped arch footing/curve/crown sections and their hidden contact faces; use shared shoreline rocks, sand and waves. Opal veins/pearls/star pendants exist in image, so add isolated attachment views only where unclear. Salt plants/seabirds/crabs proposed; tide/navigation unverified. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
